I know this is an unpopular point of view on Voat, and i am all for freedom of speech. However you can have free speech without having anarchy; a few basic rules such as are listed in the sidebars of most of the subs can make the difference between a hate fest that many people do not want to participate in and a forum where all users can feel free to engage in intelligent conversation and freely express their ideas. Voat does not need to become a "safe space" at all, but allowing an immature user that adds nothing to most of the conversations by only spamming insults and racial slurs over and over adds nothing to the site and likely actively discourages many new users from joining or participating. If a mod does not have the last resort ability to discipline an abusive user somehow when that user repeatedly and willfully violates the couple of simple rules for participating in a sub, then what power does a mod have to keep his sub from degenerating into total anarchy?
